title: Sunk Low
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.86 Numbered Discourses 4.86
  • 9. Macalavagga 9. Confirmed

Oṇatoṇatasutta Sunk Low

“Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ. “These four individuals are found in the world. Katame cattāro? What four?

  1. Oṇatoṇato, One sunk low who sinks lower,
  2. oṇatuṇṇato, one sunk low who rises high,
  3. uṇṇatoṇato, one risen high who sinks low, and
  4. uṇṇatuṇṇato. one risen high who rises higher.

… Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti. … These are the four individuals found in the world.”

Chaṭṭhaṁ.
